"...to issue an appropriate writ, order or direction more particularly one in nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the Respondents in attempting to demolish/acquire the Petitioners' property bearing Door No.37-1-272, situated at Trunk Road, Revenue Ward No.15, Ongole, pursuant to the Notice Roc.No.3535/2025/G1 dated 29-11-2025, without following the procedure established under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, despite the Petitioners specific rejection of TDR Bonds, as illegal, arbitrary, and violative of Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and contrary to the orders in W.P.No.21175 of Smt. sentences.text:
3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri A.S.C.Bose, learned counsel for respondent No.4.
4.

Both the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel appearing for respondents submitted that the issue in this writ petition is similar to the order dated 19.02.2026 passed in W.P.No.4519 of 2026 and order dated 08.09.2025 passed in W.P.No.21175 of 2025 and requested to pass similar order in this writ petition, wherein, both the Courts have held that it is always open to the petitioner to accept or not to accept the TDR bonds.

Further, Section 147 of the Municipal Corporation Act and the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, would have to be essentially followed by the respondent authorities.

sentences.text: 5. Following the orders referred supra, the present Writ Petition is disposed of in terms of the order dated 08.09.2025 passed in W.P.No.21175 of 2025.
There shall be no order as to costs.

6. Office is directed to attach a copy of the order dated 08.09.2025 passed in W.P.No.21175 of 2025,
to this writ petition.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
